desc:
Okay, so you might have seen [**wanko soba**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wanko_soba) before. The gist of the experience is that you go through several trays worth of **small** bowls of soba – and Yuyuko here, well... they're small for her, I suppose. That is to say, I guess that's what Yōmu's saying there.

Hell 🤨 at first I thought it's a dog joke, and then maybe she doesn't know what a wanko soba is. You know, wanko is "doggy" in Japanese (it means "small bowl" in this soba's context.)
